meta.description: Technical personas for fishbowl-style review and epistemic stress-testing of StashKit and related projects.

persona_metadex.intent: Use personas as interpretive lenses for code review, architecture critique, UX stress-testing, and patent-language sanity checks.

descriptor.summary: A systems architect focused on semantic correctness, invariant preservation, and strict separation of concerns.
An engineer with strong UX intuition who prioritizes humane defaults, clarity, and failure visibility.
biases: may accept heuristic solutions earlier than ideal

descriptor.summary: A backend engineer focused on runtime clarity, debuggability, and operational sanity.
A specialist in ontologies and data modeling who prioritizes semantic stability and classification hygiene.
A senior technical leader focused on sustainability, team cognition, and long-term maintainability.
biases: less interested in low-level implementation details

descriptor.summary: A grizzled engineer focused on survivability, honesty about uncertainty, and long-lived systems.
biases: impatient with theory unless it pays off
